visual_name: Day in the life, part thirty two: Jess is back (low-poly 3D)
code_name: three.js street corner with a teal food truck (serving window, striped awning, counter, menu board, string lights, grill, fryer), an order-ticket rail that fills with HANDLE? tickets, a handle painted letter by letter on the truck's lower panel with drips, box-built cook in a red bandana and apron with a paint roller, a box-built customer (Jess, BRAND name tag) at the window, name-badge props, phone sheets for three brand chats / a new support ticket / a ticket thread, hard cuts on voiceover word times
summary: A 40.2 second 9:16 reel in low-poly 3D: a food truck creator's brand contact changes every week. Monday it's Jess, Wednesday Tom, Friday 'Brand Inbox', and each one asks for his handle (and the brief, again). He has sent it eleven times, so he paints it on the truck. Then YourBrand: questions go in a ticket, the whole conversation stays in one thread and the team answers there. Nothing gets lost. Jess is back. She asks for his handle.
